intro: Finding the perfect pool hairstyles can completely change your summer routine, taking you from swimming laps to sipping margaritas without a massive detangling session. When the weather heats up, nobody wants hair sticking to their neck or getting ruined by chlorine. The trick to looking effortlessly chic by the water is having a few go-to accessories and protective styles that actually stay put. Whether you are lounging on a floatie or chasing kids around the splash pad, these functional yet trendy looks will keep your hair secure and stylish. From oversized claw clips to silk scrunchies that prevent breakage, I have rounded up my absolute favorite essentials to help you nail your waterside aesthetic. Grab your sunscreen and let us dive into these summer hair must-haves!

picks.description: A massive matte claw clip is the ultimate holy grail for keeping your hair completely dry while lounging in the shallow end. This accessory effortlessly scoops up even the thickest, longest hair into a chic French twist or a messy bun in seconds. The matte finish provides extra grip, meaning it will not slide out of your hair the moment you start sweating or get a little splash of water on it. It is incredibly gentle, preventing the dreaded ponytail headache that ruins so many beach days. Plus, when you are ready to let your hair down for a post-pool dinner, you will have gorgeous, heatless waves instead of an awkward dent. Keep one in your tote bag at all times for instant elevation.
picks.best_for: Thick or long hair that needs serious hold.
picks.quirky_fact: Twist your hair upward and fold the ends down before clipping to hide split ends.
picks.shop_query: large matte claw clip for thick hair

picks.description: Swap out your standard hair ties for a high-quality silk or satin scrunchie designed to repel water and protect your delicate strands. Chlorine and salt water can make hair incredibly brittle, and tight elastics only cause further breakage when wet. A silk scrunchie glides effortlessly over damp hair, making it the absolute best choice for securing a high topknot or a low, sleek ponytail at the pool. The smooth fabric prevents friction and frizz, ensuring your hair stays healthy all summer long. Choose a bright, vibrant color like hot pink or neon orange to add a fun, summery pop to your swimsuit ensemble while keeping those annoying flyaways firmly out of your face.
picks.best_for: Preventing breakage on wet, fragile hair.
picks.quirky_fact: Coat your hair in a leave-in conditioner before tying it up to create a hydrating mask while you swim.

picks.description: A wide brim straw visor is the brilliant solution for anyone who loves wearing a messy bun but still desperately needs sun protection for their face. Traditional sun hats force you to wear your hair down, which is a nightmare on a ninety-degree day. The open-top design of a straw visor allows you to pile your hair as high as you want, keeping your neck cool and completely sweat-free. Look for one with an adjustable velcro closure in the back so it stays secure even when a summer breeze picks up. It instantly gives off a luxurious, resort-ready vibe while serving a highly practical purpose, making it an absolute must-have for your upcoming tropical vacation or weekend pool party.
picks.best_for: Topknot lovers who want UV protection.
picks.quirky_fact: Roll up your straw visor when packing; a high-quality one will snap right back into shape.
picks.shop_query: roll up wide brim straw visor hat

picks.description: If you want to look like you just stepped out of a chic European beach club, a minimalist French pin is your best friend. This sleek, U-shaped hair fork secures a twisted bun without a single elastic, making it the most damage-free way to wear your hair up at the pool. It looks incredibly elegant and sophisticated, yet takes less than ten seconds to execute once you get the hang of the twisting motion. Because it is made of smooth metal or acetate, it is completely waterproof and will not stretch out or snap like a traditional hair tie. It is the perfect accessory for transitioning straight from afternoon sunbathing to evening cocktails without needing a mirror to touch up your look.
picks.best_for: Medium length hair and minimalist aesthetics.
picks.quirky_fact: Weave the pin through the outer edge of your bun and flip it inward to lock the style tightly in place.
picks.shop_query: acetate U shaped french hair pin

picks.description: A plush terry cloth headband is a retro-inspired accessory making a massive comeback this summer, and it is absolutely perfect for the pool. Not only does it hold back your curtain bangs and baby hairs, but the towel-like material actually absorbs sweat and splashes, keeping your hairline fresh. It is incredibly comfortable for all-day wear and will not dig behind your ears like hard plastic headbands often do. Pair a pastel terry headband with a slicked-back ponytail for a sporty, athletic-chic vibe that looks intentional and put together. It is also a lifesaver for keeping your hair completely out of the way while you reapply your facial sunscreen or sip on an icy beverage in the cabana.
picks.best_for: Keeping bangs and baby hairs away from a sweaty forehead.
picks.quirky_fact: Throw your terry headband in the washing machine with your beach towels to keep it fresh and clean all summer.
picks.shop_query: thick plush terry cloth spa headband

picks.description: When you want to wear your hair down but cannot stand the wind blowing it into your lip gloss, pearl embellished bobby pins are the ultimate stylish compromise. Simply create a deep side part and stack three or four of these oversized, decorative pins right above your ear. This keeps the bulk of your hair secured away from your face while still allowing you to show off your beachy waves. The pearls add a touch of mermaid-core glamour that looks stunning against a simple black swimsuit. Because they are so small and easy to pack, you can keep a handful in your sunglasses case for emergency styling whenever the humidity starts making your face-framing layers unruly.
picks.best_for: Securing face-framing layers while leaving the rest of the hair down.
picks.quirky_fact: Spray the crinkled side of the bobby pin with dry shampoo before sliding it in for maximum, slip-free grip.
picks.shop_query: oversized pearl bobby pins hair clips

picks.description: Spiral cord hair ties, often called telephone cord ties, are an absolute necessity for anyone who actually plans on getting their hair wet in the pool. Unlike fabric elastics that stay soggy for hours and drip down your back, these smooth plastic coils completely repel water. They dry instantly the second you step out of the pool. Even better, the unique spiral design distributes pressure unevenly, which completely prevents those frustrating ponytail creases and tension headaches. You can tie your hair into a messy bun for swimming laps, and later take it down to reveal voluminous, kink-free hair. They are incredibly durable, stretch to accommodate massive amounts of hair, and shrink right back to their original size in hot water.
picks.best_for: Active swimmers who want a waterproof, crease-free hold.
picks.quirky_fact: If your spiral tie gets permanently stretched out, blast it with a hair dryer for ten seconds to shrink it.
picks.shop_query: clear spiral telephone cord hair ties

picks.description: A vibrantly printed silk hair scarf is the most versatile accessory you can possibly bring to a pool party. You can fold it into a triangle and tie it under your hair for a vintage bandana look that protects your scalp from sunburn, or weave it through a classic three-strand braid to make your hair look instantly thicker and more styled. Silk is incredibly gentle on fragile, sun-baked strands, reducing friction and preventing frizz caused by the humid summer air. A bold floral or geometric print instantly elevates even the most basic swimsuit into a curated, fashionable outfit. It takes zero heat styling to look incredibly chic, making it the ultimate lazy-girl hack for luxurious summer beauty.
picks.best_for: Adding a pop of color and protecting the scalp from sunburn.
picks.quirky_fact: Tie the scarf around the base of your ponytail and let the long ends drape down for a romantic, effortless look.
picks.shop_query: square silk printed hair scarf bandana

picks.description: For those trendy bubble braids and intricate half-up styles you see all over your social media feeds, a pack of mini clear hair elastics is completely non-negotiable. These tiny bands grip the hair tightly without adding any visual bulk, allowing the style itself to be the main focus. Bubble braids are exceptionally perfect for the pool because they keep long hair contained and tangle-free, even if you are diving underwater or riding down a waterslide. The clear color blends seamlessly into any hair hue, from platinum blonde to raven black. Just be sure to coat your hair in a UV-protectant spray or a lightweight hair oil before securing them to ensure they slide out gently at the end of the day.
picks.best_for: Creating trendy bubble braids or intricate braided pigtails.
picks.quirky_fact: Use a small pair of cuticle scissors to carefully snip the elastics out at the end of the day to avoid ripping your hair.
picks.shop_query: clear mini rubber bands hair elastics

picks.description: The classic eighties banana clip has officially returned, and it is arguably the most flattering pool accessory you can own. This brilliant clip creates the illusion of a significantly longer, more voluminous ponytail by cascading your hair vertically down the back of your head rather than bunching it up in one single spot. A waterproof acrylic version is perfect for keeping your hair elevated and off your sticky neck while lounging in a beach chair. It distributes the weight of your hair evenly, making it incredibly comfortable for thick or heavy hair that usually causes headaches. It gives you a beautifully full, cascading look that takes exactly three seconds to achieve, making it a staple for your summer beauty arsenal.
picks.best_for: Creating the illusion of a thicker, longer ponytail without extensions.
picks.quirky_fact: Insert the clip from the bottom of your neck and pull upward to gather every single stray hair into the clip.
picks.shop_query: matte acrylic banana clip for thick hair

faqs.question: How can I protect my hair from chlorine before swimming?
faqs.answer: The best trick is to rinse your hair with fresh water before jumping in. Hair is like a sponge; if it is already saturated with clean water, it absorbs significantly less chlorinated pool water. Follow up by applying a generous layer of leave-in conditioner or coconut oil to create a protective barrier against harsh chemicals.

faqs.question: What is the best hairstyle for swimming laps?
faqs.answer: A tight topknot secured with a waterproof spiral tie or a classic French braid are your best options for active swimming. These styles keep your hair completely contained, preventing massive tangles and ensuring no loose strands block your vision while you are underwater. Always use snag-free accessories to prevent breakage.

faqs.question: How do I prevent my hair from getting frizzy at the pool?
faqs.answer: Humidity is the main culprit for pool-side frizz. To combat this, use a smoothing anti-frizz serum on damp hair before styling. Opting for sleek, pulled-back looks like a tight bun or a slicked-back ponytail using a deeply hydrating gel will keep flyaways locked down perfectly all day long.

faqs.question: Are metal hair clips safe to wear in the pool?
faqs.answer: While metal clips look beautiful, they can rust quickly if exposed to chlorine or saltwater. It is much better to choose high-quality acetate, matte plastic, or silicone-coated clips for water activities. If you do wear metal pins, make sure to dry them thoroughly immediately after your swim to prolong their lifespan.
